home.buildTitle: What we build and look after
home.buildLead: Four practices that work as one. Start with the one closest to what you need; the others are there when the work calls for them.
home.serveLead: Organisations of different sizes come to us at different moments. Most arrive through one of these three doors.

build.title: Teams building something new
build.body: A product, a platform or an internal system that has to work from the first day. We design it, build it, and stay until your team can run it.

run.title: Organisations running critical systems
run.body: Systems that cannot go down and data that cannot leak. We test them, harden them, watch them, and respond when something goes wrong.

ai.title: Businesses putting AI to work
ai.body: Assistants, agents and automation inside the systems you already use, built with the same care for security and cost as everything else.

home.approachLead: A few things we hold to, whatever the project and wherever it is.
home.statementBody: Doing it properly means agreeing the scope in writing, explaining what we find in plain words, and leaving you able to work without us.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.lead: Every certificate we issue carries a verification code. Type it in below and this page will tell you whether the certificate is genuine and still valid.

verify.codeHint: Printed on the certificate, usually next to the QR code.
verify.validBody: This certificate was issued by CyBarq Technology and is valid.
verify.revokedBody: This certificate was issued by CyBarq Technology but has since been revoked and is no longer valid.
verify.notFoundBody: We could not find a certificate with this code. Check the code for typing mistakes and try again. If you believe this is an error, contact info@cybarq.com.

verify.note: This page shows only the information printed on the certificate. For questions about a certificate, contact info@cybarq.com.
